business_problem: WTW needed to digitize fragmented commercial-insurance workflows so brokers and underwriters could exchange risk information much faster without relying on disconnected manual processes.
solution_summary: WTW built the Neuron trading platform on MongoDB Atlas to create a digital marketplace for commercial insurance. The platform connects brokers and underwriters through APIs, manages varied risk data in a multi-tenant environment, and serves both internal teams and client-facing workflows from a shared document-based foundation. Atlas gives WTW the schema flexibility to support multiple lines of business, versioned APIs, and new integrations without locking the company into a rigid relational model, while still acting as the central store of truth for the platform. Neuron augments submissions with third-party data, supports dashboards for both internal and external users, and helps automate the flow of risk information so processes that once took hours, days, or weeks can move toward seconds and minutes. The result is a more modular, analytics-friendly foundation for insurer capacity, broker access, and risk evaluation.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Acts as Neuron's central document store and system of truth for API-driven commercial-insurance workflows.

data_flow: Risk submissions flow from brokers into Neuron through APIs, MongoDB Atlas stores and normalizes the varied insurance data, third-party information augments those data packets, and the platform returns decisions, dashboards, and workflow outputs to underwriters, brokers, and internal teams.
business_outcome: WTW simplified complex insurance trading workflows, improved access to risk and capital information, and created a flexible data platform that supports faster decisions for both internal teams and market participants.
metrics: WTW aimed to turn processes that traditionally take hours, days, or weeks into processes that take seconds or minutes.
architecture_clues: Neuron is a multi-tenant, API-driven digital marketplace.
MongoDB Atlas sits at the center of the environment as the document store and system of truth.
The platform exposes analytics dashboards to both internal users and customers.
evidence_quotes: “We asked ourselves, can we effectively take something that traditionally takes hours, days and weeks, and turn it into something that takes seconds or minutes?”
“This is an internal system, it’s a client-facing system, and it’s a multi-tenant system.”
“MongoDB Atlas now sits at the center of our environment. It’s our version of the truth. It’s our document store.”
“The end result is a platform that maximizes insurers’ risk capacity, optimizes brokers’ access to capital, and creates a robust, flexible, and powerful data foundation for evaluating risks.”
